title: Bartlett Oxford - Caramel Shell Cordovan
description: The Bartlett Oxford is our most classic and sophisticated dress shoe yet. Pair these with a suit or dress slacks to refine your tailored look. The Bartlett is cut from Genuine Horween Shell Cordovan and fully lined with calfskin lining. Shell Cordovan is the finest leather in the world and will last more than a lifetime! We've fitted this classic oxford with a pair of our "Watertight" leather soles that provide superior durability and water resistance. Made in Maine, USA. Blake Welt Stitch Construction.
